title: Dollar Cost Averaging Silver Strategy Explained
readerPromise: Show a first-time silver buyer how to build and follow a practical monthly buying plan.

reel.topic: Build a monthly silver buying rule
reel.promise: Give the viewer a repeatable buying rule they can use this month.

sections.heading: What Dollar Cost Averaging Means for Silver
sections.readerQuestion: How does dollar cost averaging work when the asset is physical silver?
sections.purpose: Define the strategy in practical physical-metal terms.
keyPoints: Separate the process from short-term price predictions

sections.heading: Choose a Monthly Silver Budget
sections.readerQuestion: How much should a buyer commit each month?
sections.purpose: Turn available cash flow into a sustainable buying limit.
keyPoints: Use money left after bills and emergency savings
Choose an amount that can continue during price swings

sections.heading: Set a Fixed Buying Date
sections.readerQuestion: When should the monthly purchase happen?
sections.purpose: Create a repeatable schedule that removes impulsive timing decisions.
keyPoints: Tie the purchase to a predictable payday
Use the same date or week each month

sections.heading: Choose the Silver Products You Will Buy
sections.readerQuestion: Which coins, rounds, or bars belong in the plan?
sections.purpose: Define a simple product rule before shopping.
keyPoints: Compare premiums using the same unit
Favor recognizable products that fit the monthly budget

sections.heading: Record Every Purchase and Average Cost
sections.readerQuestion: What information should the buyer track?
sections.purpose: Make the strategy measurable and auditable.
keyPoints: Record ounces, metal cost, premium, shipping, and date
Calculate total cost divided by total ounces

sections.heading: Handle High Premium Months
sections.readerQuestion: What should the buyer do when premiums rise sharply?
sections.purpose: Explain how to preserve discipline without accepting any price.
keyPoints: Keep the budget fixed and adjust product size when necessary

sections.heading: Avoid Common Dollar Cost Averaging Mistakes
sections.purpose: Prevent impulse purchases and inconsistent record keeping.
keyPoints: Do not chase a sudden price move
Do not ignore premiums and transaction costs

sections.heading: Review the Plan Every Three Months
sections.readerQuestion: When should the buyer change the plan?
sections.purpose: Create a measured review point without encouraging constant adjustment.
keyPoints: Review budget, average cost, and product availability
Change the rule only when finances or goals change
